crossRefs.note: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot; and you will cast all their sins into the…
But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness…
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…

translations.web: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
translations.bsb: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
translations.kjv: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
translations.asv: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.
